title: Record the source value that finishes register 354
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 20745, register 258 holds `-1` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- The addition multiplies that value by `1/2` and contributes `-1/2` to register 354, which already holds `-1/2`.
- One earlier addition, event 20719, writes that `-1`. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
